recommendation: Keep the fix as a bounded completion of FHIR-36341. Do not fold unrelated resource separator cleanup into this seed without separate Jira evidence.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive OO issue requesting Observation V2 mapping table separator consistency: hyphen between v2 segment and field number and dot for components, including OBX.21, OBR.22, MSH.7, OBX.15, OBX.2, OBX.5, OBX.6, NTE.3, and OBX.7.
initial_application: Commit 534cae66862aa506b8910ccfdfc561a781efc16f, merged via HL7/fhir#2182, corrected the direct Observation StructureDefinition V2 map values. The current direct Observation mappings remain hyphenated, but active Quantity datatype V2 mapping cells still used the listed OBX.6 field notation.
additional_context: The linked Zulip discussion confirmed hyphen for fields and dot for components. OO minutes show FHIR-36341 was included in the April 2022 block vote accepted 10-0-3. Quantity is an active datatype source in source/fhir.ini, so its OBX quantity mapping text is current build-scope source rather than historical output.
reconciliation: Changed the three Quantity datatype V2 mapping cells from `(see OBX.6 etc.) / CQ.2` to `(see OBX-6 etc.) / CQ.2`, preserving the correct CQ.2 component notation.
source_changes: source/datatypes/quantity.xml: changed Quantity.unit, Quantity.system, and Quantity.code V2 mappings from `(see OBX.6 etc.) / CQ.2` to `(see OBX-6 etc.) / CQ.2`.
